evidence.ref: A new NON-LLM bridge module .warp/tracker_bridge.py: reconcile_drafts(adapter, config, store, owner) is pure control logic over the INJECTED WARP-0603 adapter seam and an injected SpecStore. It lists candidate tickets through the seam (adapter.list_intake_items) and for each candidate with no existing spec runs the SHIPPED intake (draft_spec_from_item from .warp/tracker_intake.py) to produce a warp.spec/v1 status:draft bound to the resolved repo, rendered by render_spec_markdown and written under that repo's specs/ via store.write_spec. The candidate rule draft_candidate is the two-leg pre-approval subset of the eligibility triple: assignee equals the single configured Agent user (config 'agent') AND the repo tag resolves via the REUSED WARP-0601 resolver (resolve_repo), fail-closed by name, INDEPENDENT of the ready status (drafting precedes the human promote). It imports and reuses is_eligible/resolve_repo (tracker.py) and draft_spec_from_item/render_spec_markdown (tracker_intake.py); it adds no second parser and calls no agent/LLM (the module only imports tracker.py + tracker_intake.py and drives the two injected seams). The SpecStore seam + FakeSpecStore keep the gate offline (no network, no filesystem).

selftest (scripts/selftest.py, WARP-1002 block after the intake block) asserts over the FakeTracker + FakeSpecStore: the candidate is drafted bound to repo-a, the written draft is a VALID warp.spec/v1 parsed by V.check_spec with status: draft, tracker_repo: repo-a, and the source ticket linked (intake_source item: CAND). The draft-before-promote reuse of is_eligible is asserted directly: a non-ready Agent+repo ticket is a draft_candidate (True) but is_eligible is False, and the same ticket at the ready status flips is_eligible to True (the WARP-1003 promote leg).

The bridge is a RECONCILER idempotent by the durable intake_source link, not a processed-offset ledger and no second store. store.spec_id_for_source(repo, source) is the single idempotency oracle keyed on the (tracker, item) link that draft_spec_from_item records; a ticket whose spec already exists is not redrafted and its keyed surface comment is deduped, so a re-run creates no duplicate spec and no duplicate comment and leaves state byte-identical. A ticket listed twice in one batch is collapsed by the same guard (the first write registers the source, the second reuses it). The reference FilesystemSpecStore reads a written draft's intake_source back from disk with parse_yamlish (the nested-map reader, since front_matter collapses the nested intake_source), so the durable link is real, not only the fake.

selftest asserts: a first pass drafts + surfaces the candidate, then a replay over the same tracker + store records drafted == [] and commented == [] and leaves both FakeSpecStore.digest() and FakeTracker.state_digest() byte-identical; a ticket monkeypatched to list twice in one batch yields exactly one spec and one comment; and a FilesystemSpecStore over a temp dir drafts once, then a FRESH FilesystemSpecStore over the same repo reads the intake_source link off disk and drafts nothing (exactly one spec file on disk).

Two-stage (PLAN-0010 D1, 2-stage): after drafting, the bridge posts the drafted spec back onto the ticket as a KEYED comment (adapter.comment(item, body, key=_comment_key(source)) where the key is warp-draft:<tracker>:<item>), so it posts at most once under re-run. The comment body carries the drafted spec itself plus the plain instruction that a draft is NOT claimable until the human moves the ticket to the ready-for-dev status and assigns the Agent user. The bridge NEVER promotes to ready (no set_status, no status write) - promotion is the human's tracker action wired in WARP-1003 - so a draft stays unclaimable and nothing builds.

selftest asserts the candidate ticket carries exactly one comment after the first pass, keyed warp-draft:jira:CAND, and that the replay adds no new comment (keyed dedup). No set_status/transition is emitted by the bridge (the drafted spec front matter is status: draft, and the FakeTracker candidate shows no transitions).

The gate-test drives the offline FakeTracker + FakeSpecStore with TEETH (scripts/selftest.py): a candidate (Agent + resolvable repo, no existing draft) is drafted and its spec surfaced exactly once, while three single-leg negatives each produce NO draft and NO comment - a non-Agent ticket, an unassigned ticket, and a ticket with no resolvable repo tag are all skipped; run alone, the non-Agent leg and the no-repo leg each leave the store empty and the adapter with ZERO writes (adapter.writes() == []), and the already-drafted leg (a replay) produces no new draft and no new comment. Non-tautology on every leg: restoring the Agent assignee, or restoring a resolvable repo tag, or drafting into a fresh store, each makes the SAME ticket draft. draft_candidate is asserted pure (config and ticket byte-unchanged) and fail-closed on a non-dict. No live network runs in the gate; the live Jira query and the FilesystemSpecStore per-repo roots are the same reference-wired shape used elsewhere (JiraCloudAdapter reference-wired in tracker_intake.py).
